what: Every vLLM start of the Flash-Next hibrid48 row (qwen3.8-flash-next-hibrid48) between tp-rank's memory guard landing (bfbf893, 2026-10-05) and 2026-10-11, by PLE placement: the five REPLICATED ones (the whole 26.82 GiB per-layer-embedding table on each rank, MBX_PLE_REPLICATE=1) and the one SPLIT one (half a table a rank, MBX_PLE_REPLICATE=0). Every number is a measurement or a quoted log line; each block says where it was read.

sources.boots: lb/state/perf/boots-2026-10-10.jsonl and boots-2026-10-11.jsonl on box-c: each start's config, outcome, failure and failed_phase, as the LB recorded them
sources.guard: the line tp-rank's memory guard writes to /var/tmp/tp-rank-memguard.log on the box whose rank it killed (`arm_mem_guard`), quoted in the LB's failure text
sources.vllm: docker logs qwen38-cluster-vllm on each GB10 box
sources.meminfo: a read-only /proc/meminfo sampler on each GB10 box, every 3 s, during generation 193 (MemAvailable and SwapFree, MiB)
